- HARDENING_SUGGESTION (not a finding): File: .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md and workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md
  Location: "Look up before creating" bullet, sentence about resuming pr-<N>.md for same-repo PRs
  PROBLEM: Logs written before this change record same-repo PRs as a bare #N in the Reference line. The rule says "resume pr-<N>.md only when its - Reference: line does not name a PR in another repository: ... if the line names an external PR, or is ambiguous, stop and ask". A model might read a bare #N as ambiguous instead of as a same-repo reference.
  WHY: Every attempt to resume an existing same-repo PR log written under the old template would stop and ask instead of resuming, which defeats the lookup-first behaviour for old logs.
  Suggested minimal fix: In both copies, add one clause saying that a bare #N or a URL for this repository counts as a PR of this repo, not as ambiguous.
  Estimated lines changed: 2 (one sentence per copy)
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
